rows.label: FRAME RATE
rows.description: Target frames per second in races, menus and the showroom. Lower the target or the resolution if the picture stutters.

rows.label: VSYNC
rows.description: On stops tearing on a display without G-Sync or FreeSync. With either, leave it off: on, an Nvidia GPU shows frames through the desktop, without variable refresh and at a lower frame rate.

rows.label: RESOLUTION
rows.description: Choose the resolution the game renders at. Higher resolutions give sharper edges and use more GPU time.

rows.label: EXTENDED VIEW
rows.description: Show more of the track at the sides of a wide window or above and below in a tall window. Applies when you save.

rows.label: UPSCALER
rows.description: Upscales the picture from the selected resolution to your display. DLSS (NVIDIA RTX GPUs), FSR 4 (AMD Radeon RX 6000 or later and recent Ryzen APUs), FSR 2 and FSR 3 (any GPU) use the game's depth and motion and smooth edges themselves: while one runs, MSAA and post AA are off, the MSAA change from the next screen. FSR 1 (any GPU, light) upscales and sharpens the finished picture, after MSAA and post AA. Off stretches the picture.

rows.label: DLSS PRESET
rows.description: The DLSS model. Auto takes M where DLSS upscales by more than 1.8x on an RTX 40 or later GPU, else K; Default leaves the choice to the DLSS runtime and the NVIDIA app's override.

rows.label: SHARPNESS
rows.description: Sharpens the picture after the upscaler. Off leaves the picture of DLSS, FSR 2, FSR 3 or FSR 4 as it is; FSR 1 always sharpens a little.

rows.label: GRAPHICS PRESET
rows.description: Sets every setting below. Console is the game as on the console; High raises most, adds FXAA and uses 2x MSAA everywhere; Ultra also raises the level of detail, the mirror and particles and uses FXAA Extreme; Experimental adds 4x MSAA everywhere, scenery shadows, double reflection updates and crowds in every race. A change to one setting makes the preset Custom.

rows.label: SHOWROOM MSAA
rows.description: The game's multisampling in the showroom, menus, pre-race, replays and photo mode. 4x is the console's and draws the scene in three tiles, 2x in two, Off in one: fewer samples are faster and leave edges to the selected resolution. Applies from the next screen. Off while DLSS or FSR 2 / 3 upscales: the upscaler smooths edges itself.

rows.label: RACE MSAA
rows.description: The game's multisampling in races, the countdown and the results. 2x is the console's (4x in races alone on track); 4x has twice the samples and three tiles instead of two, heavy on the GPU; Off draws one tile and leaves edges to the selected resolution. Applies from the next race. Off while DLSS or FSR 2 / 3 upscales.

rows.label: ANISOTROPIC FILTERING
rows.description: Keeps textures sharp at grazing angles. Game leaves each texture the filtering the game asks for.

rows.label: LEVEL OF DETAIL
rows.description: How far cars keep their detailed models. Ultra also keeps the best model loaded for your car, at more guest memory per car. Applies from the next race.

rows.label: SCENERY SHADOWS
rows.description: Experimental, so in no other preset: shadows of the cones, barriers and other scenery in races, which the game draws only in replays and photo mode. Known bug: a shadow vanishes or flickers as its object nears the edge of the screen, most visibly on large objects.

rows.label: REFLECTION UPDATES
rows.description: How often car reflections are redrawn. The console leaves them frozen in 16-car races and split screen; Every Race redraws them there too; Double redraws twice as many faces each frame.

rows.label: MIRROR
rows.description: Full draws the mirror every frame with up to 16 cars and the cones and barriers, where the console halves its rate and draws 6 cars (12- and 16-car races).

rows.label: SOFT PARTICLES
rows.description: Smoke and dust fade where they meet the ground and cars instead of cutting into them, as the game does in replays and photo mode.

rows.label: CROWDS
rows.description: Every Race adds the crowds the console leaves out of 1- and 16-car races. Uses more guest memory.

rows.label: POST AA
rows.description: Smooths edges in the finished picture. FXAA Extreme smooths more and softens more. Off while DLSS or FSR 2 / 3 upscales: the upscaler smooths edges itself.

rows.label: BLOOM
rows.description: Full Rate updates the glow every frame, where the console skips every second one (16-car races).

rows.label: MOTION BLUR
rows.description: Blurs the road surface with speed. Off keeps the asphalt as sharp as when standing still.

rows.label: DEPTH OF FIELD
rows.description: Blurs what is out of focus in the showroom, pre-race and replay cameras and photo mode. Applies from the next screen.

rows.label: CAR DIRT
rows.description: The dirt cars gather in a race. Off leaves cars clean.
